Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management Has Raised Position in Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) as Market Valuation Rose; As Kimco Rlty Com (KIM) Valuation Declined, Goodman Financial Has Boosted Holding 
April 23, 2018 - By Henry Gaston 
Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 46.27% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management bought 2,700 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 8,535 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.47 million, up from 5,835 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pekin Singer Strauss Asset Management who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $450.85 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.04% or $3.645 during the last trading session, reaching $175.465. About 7.91M shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since April 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500. 
Goodman Financial Corp increased its stake in Kimco Rlty Corp Com (KIM) by 11.32% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Goodman Financial Corp bought 27,520 shares as the company’s stock declined 21.59% with the market. The institutional investor held 270,660 shares of the real estate investment trusts company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.91 million, up from 243,140 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Goodman Financial Corp who had been investing in Kimco Rlty Corp Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.65B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.41% or $0.055 during the last trading session, reaching $13.275. About 2.24 million shares traded. Kimco Realty Corporation (NYSE:KIM) has declined 35.77% since April 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 47.32% the S&P500. 
Goodman Financial Corp, which manages about $291.99 million and $221.21M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Amazon Com Inc Com (NASDAQ:AMZN) by 619 shares to 8,448 shares, valued at $9.88 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc Com (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,946 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 53,785 shares, and cut its stake in Vanguard Short (VCSH).
